title: erigeron pappocromus var. stellatus
intro: Erigeron pappocromus var. stellatus, commonly known as Steller's fleabane, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Steller's fleabane are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
